---
title: "Version History"
description: "Previous versions of course materials for ECON1550 International Finance."
---

When course materials are updated (e.g., to fix a typo), the previous version is archived here.
If a file has no entries below, it has not been revised since its initial release.

<div id="version-history">
<p><em>Loading version history...</em></p>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  fetch('files/version_manifest.json')
    .then(function(r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
    .catch(function() { return null; })
    .then(function(data) {
      var container = document.getElementById('version-history');
      if (!data || !data.versions || Object.keys(data.versions).length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p>No version history available yet.</p>';
        return;
      }

      // Group files by category
      var categories = {
        'Problem Sets': [],
        'Slides': [],
        'Lecture Notes': [],
        'Other': []
      };

      Object.keys(data.versions).sort().forEach(function(filePath) {
        var versions = data.versions[filePath];
        if (versions.length === 0) return;
        // Only show files that are currently active (released to students).
        // Pre-release or removed files should not appear in version history.
        var isActive = data.active_files && data.active_files.indexOf(filePath) !== -1;
        if (!isActive) return;
        var entry = { filePath: filePath, versions: versions };
        if (filePath.indexOf('/psets/') !== -1) categories['Problem Sets'].push(entry);
        else if (filePath.indexOf('/slides/') !== -1) categories['Slides'].push(entry);
        else if (filePath.indexOf('/lectures/') !== -1) categories['Lecture Notes'].push(entry);
        else categories['Other'].push(entry);
      });

      var html = '';
      var categoryOrder = ['Problem Sets', 'Slides', 'Lecture Notes', 'Other'];
      categoryOrder.forEach(function(cat) {
        var files = categories[cat];
        if (files.length === 0) return;
        html += '<h3>' + cat + '</h3>';
        html += '<table class="table"><thead><tr>';
        html += '<th scope="col">File</th><th scope="col">Latest</th><th scope="col">Previous Versions</th>';
        html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
        files.forEach(function(entry) {
          var fileName = entry.filePath.split('/').pop();
          html += '<tr><td>' + fileName + '</td>';
          html += '<td><a href="' + entry.filePath + '">Latest</a></td>';
          html += '<td>';
          entry.versions.forEach(function(v, i) {
            var date = new Date(v.archived_at);
            var formatted = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
              year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric'
            });
            if (i > 0) html += ', ';
            html += '<a href="' + v.path + '">' + formatted + '</a>';
          });
          html += '</td></tr>';
        });
        html += '</tbody></table>';
      });

      container.innerHTML = html;
    });
})();
</script>
